text: {"features":[{"name":"Educational attainment","description":"The letter indicates how far the applicant exceeds the role's minimum educational requirement through degree level and advanced technical study.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, which meets the minimum requirement but not the preferred advanced-degree profile."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree plus some additional academic depth, such as graduate study or research exposure, short of a completed advanced degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a master's degree in a relevant technical field, directly matching the preferred academic qualification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a master's degree and uses it to signal especially deep technical preparation for complex engineering work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a doctoral degree in a relevant technical field, clearly exceeding the preferred academic qualification."}]},{"name":"Professional experience depth","description":"The letter shows the depth of the applicant's software-engineering experience through tenure, production ownership, and evidence of testing, maintaining, and launching systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only near-minimum professional experience, with a short tenure or limited evidence of owning production services through testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows early-career experience with some production ownership, but the scope or tenure remains modest for this role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid professional experience, with multiple years in industry and credible responsibility for several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong experience depth, combining substantial tenure with repeated ownership of launching and maintaining backend systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows very strong experience depth, presenting a long track record of building, launching, and sustaining multiple production systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"The letter shows how central Go has been to the applicant's real production work, especially for backend or infrastructure systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is merely listed among languages, with no sign that it is central to the applicant's work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go is described as a regular tool, but the letter gives little evidence of primary ownership in Go-based systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Go is described as a main working language for production service development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Go is presented as the principal or daily language for backend or infrastructure work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Go is presented as a core strength tied directly to designing and operating production backend systems of the kind this role requires."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"The letter shows the applicant's depth of Python use for production services, tooling, automation, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Python is absent or only appears indirectly, leaving no clear evidence of personal proficiency."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned briefly as an auxiliary language, with little evidence of real production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Python is described as a regular tool for services, tooling, automation, or prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Python is presented as a major working language with concrete responsibility for internal services or critical automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Python is presented as deep production expertise that clearly supports building automation layers or AI agents for this role."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"The letter shows the applicant's relevance to the role's AI work through direct experience building or operating AI-enabled systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of building or deploying AI systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI interest or light exposure, but not shipped systems or operational responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant has built or shipped AI or LLM-backed features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes production AI work plus attention to reliability, hardening, or evaluation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial production AI experience with explicit safeguards, evaluation practices, or operational discipline around model behavior."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"The letter shows the applicant's experience performing real security reviews or assessments of systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of performing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals general security interest, but not actual assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant has performed security reviews or assessments in practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents security assessment as a meaningful part of the applicant's work and shows how that hands-on practice shaped engineering judgment."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"The letter shows how directly the applicant has automated vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions exposure to vulnerability response, but not ownership of automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant automated some part of vulnerability reporting or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete vulnerability-handling pipeline with functions like classification, deduplication, routing, or prioritization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents vulnerability automation as a major role-aligned achievement that clearly reduced manual security workload."}]},{"name":"Agentic system design","description":"The letter shows the applicant's experience designing agent-based systems with appropriate control, supervision, and infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of designing agentic or agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter refers to automation or agents vaguely, without describing architecture or controls."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant has built agentic systems or pipelines using relevant technologies."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes end-to-end agent architecture with explicit boundaries, supervision, permissions, or auditability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents sophisticated agent design experience that closely matches this role's pattern of Python agents governed by Go infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"The letter shows the strength of the applicant's data-structure and algorithmic thinking through concrete technical examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no evidence of noteworthy data-structure or algorithmic work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims comfort with algorithms in general terms, but gives little concrete proof."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes a clear example of improving a system through better algorithm or data-structure choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong algorithmic fluency through a substantive redesign of a hot path, scheduler, matcher, or other core system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes algorithmic reasoning a standout strength, with concrete examples showing deep performance or scalability thinking."}]},{"name":"Secure-by-default mindset","description":"The letter shows commitment to making security easier and more automatic for developers rather than relying on manual process alone.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not express a clear philosophy about embedding security into everyday development."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses generic interest in security impact, but not a clear enablement mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows interest in reducing manual security work or making security easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly frames security tooling as a way to embed protections into the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter articulates a mature enablement philosophy, such as making the secure path the easy path or scaling scarce security expertise through defaults and automation."}]},{"name":"Platform impact orientation","description":"The letter shows motivation for foundational systems work whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not show particular interest in foundational or organization-wide systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions scale or impact in broad terms, but without a platform-specific point of view."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear interest in infrastructure or work whose benefits reach multiple teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter strongly values foundational systems, quiet resilience, or capacity-building across a large organization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter vividly explains why high-leverage platform security work is motivating, emphasizing inherited benefits across many products or teams."}]},{"name":"Role-specific tailoring","description":"The letter connects the applicant's background to the actual responsibilities and context of this specific Google Information Security Engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could plausibly be sent to many software roles, with little reference to this team or its responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Google or security broadly, but only loosely connects the applicant's background to the posted role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter addresses several stated requirements or responsibilities directly."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly maps past experience to this team's work in security automation, vulnerability handling, agents, or Go backend systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter feels written for this exact role, weaving the team's mission, responsibilities, and preferred skills into a tight case for fit."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"The letter supports its claims with concrete examples, technologies, tasks, or achievements rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Most claims are generic and unsupported, with few concrete examples, technologies, or tasks."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a small number of specifics, but much of the case still relies on broad assertions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter regularly uses concrete technologies, tasks, or project examples to substantiate claims."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides multiple specific examples across different qualification areas, making the applicant's background easy to picture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter grounds nearly every important claim in precise, observable detail without reading like a checklist."}]},{"name":"Impact articulation","description":"The letter explains the outcomes or value created by the applicant's work rather than only naming activities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mostly lists responsibilities or technologies without explaining outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints that the work was useful, but describes results only vaguely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter names clear effects such as time saved, bugs eliminated, or manual work reduced."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly links past work to meaningful outcomes for teams, systems, or security operations."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes high-leverage impact central to the case, showing why the applicant's work mattered at scale."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"The letter shows the depth of the applicant's direct contribution to open-source software through patching, maintenance, or stewardship.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of contributing to or maintaining open-source software."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions open source only passively, with little sign of direct contribution."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes occasional upstream patches or limited stewardship of a small project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular contribution or maintenance responsibility for a project used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial open-source ownership, such as maintaining an actively used project, reviewing contributions, and shipping releases."}]},{"name":"Offensive security practice","description":"The letter shows the applicant's hands-on offensive security activity through recurring practice, competition, or attacker-oriented work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of hands-on offensive security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security hobbies or attacker thinking only briefly, without sustained practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows recurring hands-on practice through capture-the-flag events or similar activities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents strong ongoing offensive practice and explains how it sharpens defensive engineering judgment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional offensive credibility through near-top competitive results or similarly strong hands-on practice."}]},{"name":"Security certifications","description":"The letter shows the strength of the applicant's external security validation through recognized certifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter names no security certification."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter alludes to formal security grounding, but without a clearly recognized certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter cites a foundational credential such as Security+."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter cites a strong practical credential, but treats it mostly as a résumé item."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter cites a demanding practical credential such as OSCP and explains it as evidence of hands-on exploitation skill or assessed competence."}]},{"name":"Personal project rigor","description":"The letter shows the technical ambition of the applicant's self-directed projects outside formal job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions no meaningful personal project work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions only a very small side project with limited technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes a modest self-directed project that shows curiosity or end-to-end ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a substantial systems project with real technical difficulty, such as replication, failover, consensus, or coordination."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents an ambitious personal system whose hard edge cases or production-like standards clearly strengthen the application."}]},{"name":"Writing organization","description":"The letter is structured logically, with a clear progression from motivation to evidence to closing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter is difficult to follow or arranged in a way that weakens the argument."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a recognizable structure, but the flow feels choppy, list-like, or uneven."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally coherent and easy to follow, with a sensible progression through qualifications."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well organized, using strong sequencing and transitions to build the case."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally well structured, making the argument feel cumulative, effortless, and persuasive."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The letter maintains professional polish through spelling, grammar, and typographical accuracy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or typographical errors distract noticeably and undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Multiple visible errors appear, though the letter remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few minor errors are present, but they do not materially interfere with reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The writing is clean and polished, with only rare slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The writing is virtually error-free throughout."}]}]}
